title: Telangana HC (Justice K Lakshman, reported 9 Nov 2026) sentences Ranga Reddy Collector C Narayana Reddy (IAS) to six months' simple imprisonment and a ₹2,000 fine for contempt, suspended for four weeks so he can appeal; he had been told in August 2025 to decide within 60 days a plea to take plots off the Section 22-A prohibitory list; contempt filed 15 Oct 2025; plea rejected 26 Feb and 8 Jul 2026; court called part of his counter-affidavit 'palpably false': 'Right or wrong, the order has to be obeyed'; no response reported
sources: https://www.newsx.com/regionals/telangana-high-court-sentences-ranga-reddy-collector-to-6-months-in-jail-for-contempt-grants-4-week-relief-291028/ (read by the reviewer: 'to enable the Collector to file an appeal')
